forum.title: HSO for two motors using the ST-G473 microprocessor in MC Workbench
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello kmce,

It is indeed possible to run 2 motors with HSO theoretically speaking. However, as you mentioned, it is currently not supported yet. Despite being on the roadmap, I cannot provide any information on a possible release date of that feature yet. What can I say though is that dual motor HSO is not scheduled to be supported on STM32G4 at all. We are currently focusing on STM32C5 and onward for all new features.
forum.content_text:
Hi,

After reading HSO current and voltage sampling in three-shunt topology, I beleve it is possible to run two BLDC moters using the ST-G473 microprocessor using 2 ADC's per motor. However, there does not seem to be support for that in the MC Workbanch. Will this be available in the future?

Regards,

Kevin
